system.description:
You conjure a vine of fruits endowed with energizing magic.

When you cast this spell, you gain 2 Fruits of Longevity. These fruits can be given to other creatures and consumed as an Action to heal 2 Stamina.

Each extra success increases the number of fruits by +1.

Alternatively, you may increase the Stamina each fruit heals by +1 per extra success.

These fruits last for 1 hour, after which they whither to dust. If you cast this spell again, you may forgo growing a number of new fruits to extend the duration of fruits from a previous casting of the spell. All fruits from a previous casting that are not extended in this way immediately whither to dust.

These fruits have no nutritional value, being mere containers for magical energy. You cannot survive by eating them alone.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.dmGfXdfZVQpc0qSN]{Fruits of Longevity}
